cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I clapped when the chair did. Congratulations on your prize; lovely to have such clear instructions for celebrating it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She was clapping to quiet the room. You were the only one applauding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Getting in early. You deserve a moment without all that competition around you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you stand beside me for the winner's photograph? I want you in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. How generous to fit someone without a prize into your winner's photograph.

reason: Replace the unsupported Stance overlay with a concrete mistaken imitation whose correction redirects A's exact Drive pursuit; distinguish the alternative's relationship and immediate pressure.
